CONSTRAINT ck_expenses_itemized_columns CHECK(split_type = 'ITEMIZED' OR(subtotal_minor IS NULL AND service_bps IS NULL AND service_minor IS NULL AND tax_bps IS NULL AND tax_minor IS NULL AND tax_base IS NULL AND adjustment_minor IS NULL AND discount_bps IS NULL AND discount_amount_minor IS NULL AND discount_minor IS NULL AND service_amount_minor IS NULL AND tax_amount_minor IS NULL AND delivery_minor IS NULL))

CONSTRAINT ck_payment_handles_instapay CHECK(type <> 'INSTAPAY' OR(length(value) BETWEEN 3 AND 60 AND value GLOB '?*@?*' AND value NOT GLOB '*@*@*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._@-]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*@*_*'))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 UNIQUE CHECK (singleton = 1)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "created_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_schema_version >= 1), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_export_at" INTEGER, "last_export_format_version" INTEGER CHECK (last_export_format_version IS NULL OR last_export_format_version >= 1), "backup_reminder_snoozed_until" INTEGER, "last_reminder_tone" TEXT CHECK (last_reminder_tone IS NULL OR last_reminder_tone IN ('SOFT', 'FIRM', 'FUNNY')), "ocr_consent_at" INTEGER, "ocr_scan_day" TEXT CHECK (ocr_scan_day IS NULL OR ocr_scan_day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "ocr_scan_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ocr_scan_count >= 0), "ocr_permission_errors" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ocr_permission_errors >= 0), "ocr_hidden_until" INTEGER, CHECK((last_export_at IS NULL)=(last_export_format_version IS NULL))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_groups(id), "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_key <> '' AND name_key = lower(name_key)), "user_id" TEXT REFERENCES local_profile(id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sort_order >= 1), "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEMBER' CHECK (role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MEMBER')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'LEFT')), "joined_at" INTEGER, "left_at" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_members_group_sort_order UNIQUE(group_id, sort_order), CONSTRAINT uq_members_group_name_key UNIQUE(group_id, name_key), CONSTRAINT ck_members_owner_linked_active CHECK(role <> 'OWNER' OR(user_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE')), CONSTRAINT ck_members_left_at CHECK((status = 'LEFT')=(left_at IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_members_left_linked CHECK(status <> 'LEFT' OR user_id IS NOT NULL)) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profile(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('TRIP', 'HOUSING', 'OUTING', 'OTHER')), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK (length(currency_code) = 3 AND currency_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1), "member_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (member_seq >= 0), "treasurer_member_id" TEXT REFERENCES members(id)) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_groups_owner_created ON expense_groups (owner_user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)

CREATE TRIGGER expense_groups_treasurer_insert BEFORE INSERT ON expense_groups WHEN NEW.treasurer_member_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE id = NEW.treasurer_member_id AND group_id = NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'the treasurer must be a member of the same group');END

CREATE TRIGGER expense_groups_treasurer_update BEFORE UPDATE OF treasurer_member_id ON expense_groups WHEN NEW.treasurer_member_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE id = NEW.treasurer_member_id AND group_id = NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'the treasurer must be a member of the same group');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_members_group_user ON members (group_id, user_id) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_members_group_owner ON members (group_id) WHERE role = 'OWNER'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_groups(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "split_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (split_type IN ('EQUAL', 'EXACT', 'ITEMIZED')), "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "expense_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(expense_date) IS expense_date), "subtotal_minor" INTEGER, "service_bps" INTEGER CHECK (service_bps IS NULL OR service_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "service_minor" INTEGER, "tax_bps" INTEGER CHECK (tax_bps IS NULL OR tax_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "tax_minor" INTEGER, "tax_base" TEXT CHECK (tax_base IS NULL OR tax_base IN ('SUBTOTAL', 'SUBTOTAL_PLUS_SERVICE')), "adjustment_minor" INTEGER, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profile(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1), "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OTHER' CHECK (category IN ('FOOD', 'TRANSPORT', 'FUEL', 'ACCOMMODATION', 'GROCERIES', 'SHOPPING', 'ENTERTAINMENT', 'BILLS', 'OTHER')), "paid_from_pool" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (paid_from_pool IN (0, 1)), "discount_bps" INTEGER CHECK (discount_bps IS NULL OR discount_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 9999), "discount_amount_minor" INTEGER CHECK (discount_amount_minor IS NULL OR discount_amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "discount_minor" INTEGER, "service_amount_minor" INTEGER CHECK (service_amount_minor IS NULL OR service_amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "tax_amount_minor" INTEGER CHECK (tax_amount_minor IS NULL OR tax_amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "delivery_minor" INTEGER CHECK (delivery_minor IS NULL OR delivery_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000), CONSTRAINT ck_expenses_charge_one_form CHECK(NOT(discount_bps IS NOT NULL AND discount_amount_minor IS NOT NULL)AND NOT(service_bps IS NOT NULL AND service_amount_minor IS NOT NULL)AND NOT(tax_bps IS NOT NULL AND tax_amount_minor IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_expenses_itemized_columns CHECK(split_type = 'ITEMIZED' OR(subtotal_minor IS NULL AND service_bps IS NULL AND service_minor IS NULL AND tax_bps IS NULL AND tax_minor IS NULL AND tax_base IS NULL AND adjustment_minor IS NULL AND discount_bps IS NULL AND discount_amount_minor IS NULL AND discount_minor IS NULL AND service_amount_minor IS NULL AND tax_amount_minor IS NULL AND delivery_minor IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_expenses_itemized_charges CHECK(split_type <> 'ITEMIZED' OR(subtotal_minor IS NOT NULL AND subtotal_minor > 0 AND discount_minor IS NOT NULL AND discount_minor >= 0 AND discount_minor < subtotal_minor AND service_minor IS NOT NULL AND service_minor >= 0 AND tax_minor IS NOT NULL AND tax_minor >= 0 AND delivery_minor IS NOT NULL AND delivery_minor >= 0 AND adjustment_minor IS NOT NULL AND total_minor = subtotal_minor - discount_minor + service_minor + tax_minor + delivery_minor + adjustment_minor AND((discount_bps IS NOT NULL OR discount_amount_minor IS NOT NULL)=(discount_minor > 0))AND(discount_amount_minor IS NULL OR discount_minor = discount_amount_minor)AND(service_bps IS NOT NULL OR service_amount_minor IS NOT NULL OR service_minor = 0)AND(service_amount_minor IS NULL OR service_minor = service_amount_minor)AND(tax_bps IS NOT NULL OR tax_amount_minor IS NOT NULL OR tax_minor = 0)AND(tax_amount_minor IS NULL OR tax_minor = tax_amount_minor)AND((tax_bps IS NULL AND tax_amount_minor IS NULL)=(tax_base IS NULL))))) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_group_list ON expenses (group_id, expense_date DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_group_category ON expenses (group_id, category) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_group ON expenses (group_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_pool ON expenses (group_id) WHERE paid_from_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_payers" ("expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses(id), "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), PRIMARY KEY(expense_id, member_id)) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_payers_member ON expense_payers (member_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_splits" ("expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses(id), "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id), "owed_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (owed_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000), "items_minor" INTEGER, "service_minor" INTEGER, "tax_minor" INTEGER, "adjustment_minor" INTEGER, "discount_minor" INTEGER, "delivery_minor" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(expense_id, member_id), CONSTRAINT ck_expense_splits_breakdown CHECK((items_minor IS NULL AND discount_minor IS NULL AND service_minor IS NULL AND tax_minor IS NULL AND adjustment_minor IS NULL AND delivery_minor IS NULL)OR(items_minor IS NOT NULL AND items_minor >= 0 AND discount_minor IS NOT NULL AND discount_minor >= 0 AND discount_minor <= items_minor AND service_minor IS NOT NULL AND service_minor >= 0 AND tax_minor IS NOT NULL AND tax_minor >= 0 AND delivery_minor IS NOT NULL AND delivery_minor >= 0 AND adjustment_minor IS NOT NULL AND owed_minor = items_minor - discount_minor + service_minor + tax_minor + delivery_minor + adjustment_minor))) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_splits_member ON expense_splits (member_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sort_order >= 0), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 999), "unit_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), CONSTRAINT ux_expense_items_order UNIQUE(expense_id, sort_order), CONSTRAINT ck_expense_items_line CHECK(amount_minor = quantity * unit_amount_minor)) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_item_assignees" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_items(id), "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id), PRIMARY KEY(item_id, member_id)) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_item_assignees_member ON expense_item_assignees (member_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expenses(id), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1), "change_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (change_type IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')), "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot) AND json_type(snapshot) = 'object'), "changed_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profile(id), "changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ux_expense_revisions_version UNIQUE(expense_id, version)) STRICT;
CREATE TRIGGER expense_revisions_append_only BEFORE UPDATE ON expense_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'expense_revisions are append-only');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_groups(id), "from_member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id), "to_member_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "settled_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(settled_on) IS settled_on), "note" TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(trim(note)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "created_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profile(id), "created_by_member_id" TEXT REFERENCES members(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'DISPUTED', 'CANCELLED')), "declared_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_at" INTEGER, "disputed_at" INTEGER, "cancelled_at" INTEGER, "recorded_by_admin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (recorded_by_admin IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAYMENT' CHECK (kind IN ('PAYMENT', 'POOL_DEPOSIT')), CONSTRAINT ck_settlements_members CHECK(from_member_id <> to_member_id), CONSTRAINT ck_settlements_confirmed_at CHECK((status = 'CONFIRMED')=(confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_settlements_cancelled_at CHECK((status = 'CANCELLED')=(cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_settlements_disputed_at CHECK(status <> 'DISPUTED' OR disputed_at IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT ck_settlements_pending_clean CHECK(status <> 'PENDING' OR(disputed_at IS NULL AND confirmed_at IS NULL))) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_settlements_group_list ON settlements (group_id, settled_on DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_settlements_group_confirmed ON settlements (group_id) WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED'
CREATE INDEX ix_settlements_from_member ON settlements (from_member_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_settlements_to_member ON settlements (to_member_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_settlements_deposits ON settlements (group_id) WHERE kind = 'POOL_DEPOSIT'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_handles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profile(id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('INSTAPAY', 'WALLET')), "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_payment_handles_user_type UNIQUE(user_id, type), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_handles_wallet CHECK(type <> 'WALLET' OR value GLOB '01[0125][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'), CONSTRAINT ck_payment_handles_instapay CHECK(type <> 'INSTAPAY' OR(length(value) BETWEEN 3 AND 60 AND value GLOB '?*@?*' AND value NOT GLOB '*@*@*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._@-]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*@*_*'))) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "idempotency_keys" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length("key") = 36), "endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_status" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (response_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599), "response_body" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(response_body)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_idempotency_keys_created ON idempotency_keys (created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fuel_prices" ("fuel_type" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (fuel_type IN ('GASOLINE_80', 'GASOLINE_92', 'GASOLINE_95', 'DIESEL')), "price_per_litre_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (price_per_litre_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 100000), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;
